name: judge
notes: Validator-only: kodo.validator._evaluate selects it over the wire to score a finished run. `selectable: false` keeps it out of the served catalog — its prompt is written to grade a transcript, not to hold a conversation — while leaving it fully registered and runnable. It has no aliases because its wire value was always its own name.
label: Judge
description: Scores a finished run against the scenario's rubric, for kodo.validator.
